text:
maria: quick RFC follow-up: when we flipped per-head FP8 for compact-13b on staging we saw a reproducible short-context EM drop (~3%).
jon: is that only for seq_len <= 64?
maria: yes, mostly <=64. long completions unchanged.
priya: any calibration logs?
maria: attached summary: first 4 layers show larger zero-mean drift after quant calib.
rahul: sounds like calibration set mismatch for prefix tokens. short prompts have different activation shapes.
jon: options: 1) runtime short-seq fallback to INT8, 2) store a tiny prefix-correction table in the precision profile, 3) do online quick recalib at serve.
priya: runtime fallback is easiest to ship: one kernel switch on request length. low dev risk.
rahul: prefix-correction table seems promising: offline compute per-head scale+bias for early token positions, embed into profile as a small blob. runtime applies vector add/mul pre-attn. keeps perf for fp8 on long requests.
maria: size constraints? ops will want small profile blobs.
priya: aim for <32KB per model variant. we can quantize prefix table to int16 to save space.
jon: need profile schema change. sketch: precision_profile.short_ctx = [ {"max_len":"64","prefix_blob_checksum":"sha256...","blob_version":"v1"} ]
rahul: runtime: pick best matching short_ctx entry by seq_len and apply transform. also verify checksum at load. fallback to INT8 if mismatch or missing.
maria: oncall playbook if short-prompt errors spike?
jon: set env QUICK_QUANT_FALLBACK=1 to force INT8, rollback profile, and contact eng-ml.
priya: rollout plan: 1) spec PR for schema 2) offline generator for top 5 models 3) runtime loader + checksum 4) shadow canary 5) 1% canary with fallback guard
deploy-bot: canary created: CANARY-QUANT-1822 watching eng-ml, eng-runtime, opsahul: metrics to track: short-prompt EM, BLEU, latency P95, profile blob load failures.
maria: decision: implement prefix_blob in profile + short-seq INT8 guard. feature-flagged rollout.
priya: I'll open the generator PR and include size and checksum examples.
jon: I'll add a small stager test harness for <=64 suite.
maria: thanks all 680
